subject: Staged Uplift & Transitional Rate Cap — Negotiation
messages:
From: Elena Cruz <elena.cruz@optimaretail.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal window + expected uplift

Hi Ben / Rishi,

Thanks for the walkthrough yesterday. Optima's renewal window is coming up and finance asked me to get a concrete proposal on the table — they want to extend the term to 24 months but are asking for a phased pricing plan so we can absorb the uplift over two quarters. Key asks from my side: a max per-token rate cap for the first 6 months, a schedule for the committed capacity increases (we'll move from 100k -> 250k tokens/day over three months), and some one-time onboarding credits to offset migration costs.

Can you share a sketch by EOD tomorrow? We prefer to keep this in a single addendum rather than multiple amendments.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Cruz
Head of Procurement, Optima Retail
elena.cruz@optimaretail.com
+1 415-555-0198

--
Attachment: optima_usage_projection.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Cruz <elena.cruz@optimaretail.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-30T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal window + expected uplift

Elena — thanks for the clear asks. High level response below; I'll put a formal addendum draft in Drive and share a PDF.

1) Term: 24 months, effective on the existing contract anniversary.
2) Committed capacity ramp: 100k (current) -> 175k (month 1-2) -> 250k (month 3+). We will tier the commit so overage billing aligns with the ramp.
3) Transitional rate cap: we can offer a 6-month capped per-token ceiling of $0.00095 (after which standard tiered rates apply). Cap applies to all usage up to 250k tokens/day.
4) Onboarding credit: one-time $35k credit applied to first invoice after ramp completes.

I'll loop in Marissa to check margin and credit approval. If this is acceptable we can convert into an addendum and Rishi will run the billing/ops work to ensure SKU mapping.

Proposed next step: 30-minute sync tomorrow to align legal/finance redlines.

Best,
Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

Attachment: (will share) 20260630-Optima-draft-addendum-v1.pdf (draft addendum stub)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-30T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal window + expected uplift (internal)

Ben / Rishi — quick internal: finance approved the $35k onboarding credit conditional on a minimum annual committed spend of $420k over the 24 months. Margin team flagged the 6-month cap at $0.00095 as tight but acceptable if we require a quarterly true-up clause and an automatic conversion to the contracted tiered rates after month 6. Recommend we add:

- Quarterly usage review with right to adjust commit band if weekly-average delta > 30% for two consecutive quarters.
- A one-time migration services invoice itemized (so Optima sees the credits vs services).

I'll prepare a short redline for the addendum — Ben please share the projection file from Elena so I can confirm the math.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Success // Redwood Inference

From: Elena Cruz <elena.cruz@optimaretail.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@optimaretail.com
Date: 2026-07-01T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal window + expected uplift

Thanks Ben — that structure looks promising. Two clarifying points before we lock: 1) the cap needs to include inference and embedding usage (both product lines), and 2) the quarterly review cadence is fine but we need visibility into token-level usage by route (embedding vs text).

We can do the 30-minute sync tomorrow 10am PT. I'll invite legal and finance.

Also noted on the conditional spend threshold — procurement will confirm if Optima can commit to $420k ARR in the 24-month term; if not, we may need to trade down the onboarding credit.

Elena

Elena / Ben — thanks, I'll own the SKU mapping and billing behavior. A couple operational notes:

- We'll include per-route usage breakdowns in the monthly usage report (embedding vs inference) and can provide a token CSV export for finance during the first three months of ramp.
